headline: Planzer says hackers stole shipment data on parcels sent from 2018 to early 2023, including Digitec Galaxus customers' orders.
summary: New incident page. Planzer's statement, quoted by Netzwoche (s002) and Inside IT (s003) on Nov 26: shipment data sent through its interfaces or customer portal stolen; shippers' portal logins taken in encrypted form; recipients' portal logins and payment and financial data not affected; found through unusual activity; BACS and FDPIC told; criminal complaint. Planzer's spokesperson told AWP (s001, Nov 27) that data on all Planzer Paket parcels from Jan 1, 2018, to Feb 26, 2023, is affected, with no count and no start date given. Digitec Galaxus says its order data (parcel numbers, names, delivery addresses, emails, some phone numbers; newest early 2023) was taken and its own systems were not; Brack.ch says it was not affected (AWP). Main answer Confirmed, filed under hack-stated, on Planzer's own statement carried by three outlets. incident_type breach; no service (deliveries continue). Size Large. Planzer's and Galaxus's own pages (s005, s006) block automated readers and were not read. Picture: Wikimedia Commons photograph of a Planzer lorry (CC BY-SA 4.0), cropped to leave out another company's sign. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread; Reddit not reachable. Privacy check done: the spokesperson is given by role.
